$comment: Flow authors browser UI (the annotation layer, the verify-build report renderer) but has no launchable app — platform stays 'library' so /flow:verify-build does not fire on every markdown PR. This recipe exists so the UI it DOES ship can be rendered and driven on demand: point verifyReportPath into .flow/, render, then serve it here. See dev-docs/roadmap.md § 'Flow cannot capture frames of its own overlay'.
